1	# StreamWave — Unlimited Films, Series and More
     2	
     3	## Brand
     4	StreamWave is a premium streaming platform offering unlimited access to films, series, anime, documentaries and more on any device. The brand identity is bold, dark, and modern — designed to immerse visitors in a cinematic experience from the moment they land on the page.
     5	
     6	Brand colors: `#000000` (primary background), `#E50914` (accent red), `#FFFFFF` (primary text)
     7	
     8	## Hero Content
     9	Title: **Unlimited films, series and more**
    10	Subtitle: Starts at $15.98. Cancel at any time.
    11	Prompt: Ready to watch? Enter your email to create or restart your membership.
    12	Input: Email address (placeholder)
    13	CTA: **"Get Started ›"**
    14	
    15	Background: Full-bleed mosaic of tilted movie/show poster artwork with a dark gradient overlay.
    16	
    17	## Trending Content
    18	Section heading: **Trending now**
    19	Display: Horizontal scrollable carousel with large rank numbers overlaid on each title card. Carousel advances via a right-arrow control.
    20	
    21	| Rank | Title |
    22	|------|-------|
    23	| 1 | Bloodhounds |
    24	| 2 | BEEF |
    25	| 3 | XO, Kitty |
    26	| 4 | War Machine |
    27	| 5 | Bridgerton |
    28	| 6 | Stranger Things |
    29	| 7 | Agent from Above |
    30	| 8 | Boyfriend on Demand |
    31	| 9 | KPop Demon Hunters |
    32	| 10 | Emily in Paris |
    33	
    34	## Platform Features
    35	Section heading: **More reasons to join**
    36	Four feature cards displayed in a horizontal row, each with a title, description, and an icon at the bottom-right corner.
    37	
    38	- **Enjoy on your TV** — Watch on smart TVs, PlayStation, Xbox, Chromecast, Apple TV, Blu-ray players and more.
    39	- **Download your series to watch offline** — Save your favourites easily and always have something to watch.
    40	- **Watch everywhere** — Stream unlimited films and series on your phone, tablet, laptop and TV.
    41	- **Create profiles for children** — Send children on adventures with their favourite characters in a space made just for them — free with your membership.
    42	
    43	## Frequently Asked Questions
    44	Section heading: **Frequently Asked Questions**
    45	Display: Accordion — clicking a question expands its answer; any previously open item collapses.
    46	
    47	- **What is StreamWave?**
    48	  StreamWave is a streaming service that offers a wide variety of award-winning TV programmes, films, anime, documentaries and more — on thousands of internet-connected devices. You can watch as much as you want, whenever you want, without a single advert — all for one low monthly price. There's always something new to discover, and new TV programmes and films are added every week!
    49	
    50	- **How much does StreamWave cost?**
    51	  Watch StreamWave on your smartphone, tablet, smart TV, laptop or streaming device, all for one fixed monthly fee. Plans range from $15.98 to $29.98/month.
    52	
    53	- **Where can I watch?**
    54	  Watch anywhere, anytime. Sign in with your StreamWave account to watch instantly on the web from your personal computer or on any internet-connected device that offers the StreamWave app, including smart TVs, smartphones, tablets, streaming media players and game consoles. You can also download your favourite programmes with the iOS or Android app. Use downloads to watch while you're on the go and without an internet connection. Take StreamWave with you anywhere.
    55	
    56	- **How do I cancel?**
    57	  StreamWave is flexible. You can easily cancel your account online in two clicks. There are no cancellation fees — start or stop your account at any time.
    58	
    59	- **What can I watch on StreamWave?**
    60	  StreamWave has an extensive library of feature films, documentaries, series, anime, award-winning StreamWave originals, and more. Watch as much as you want, any time you want.
    61	
    62	- **Is StreamWave good for children?**
    63	  The StreamWave Children's experience is included in your membership to give parents control while children enjoy family-friendly TV programmes and films in their own space. Children's profiles come with PIN-protected parental controls that let you restrict the maturity rating of content children can watch and block specific titles you don't want children to see.
    64	
    65	## Pricing Information
    66	- Starting price: **$15.98/month**
    67	- Plan range: $15.98 – $29.98/month
    68	- **Cancel at any time** — no cancellation fees
    69	
    70	## CTA Section (Bottom)

    72	Input: Email address (placeholder)
    73	CTA: **"Get Started ›"**
    74	
    75	## Login Form
    76	Heading: **Enter your info to sign in**

    78	Fields:
    79	- Email address or mobile number
    80	- Password
    81

    86	- Logo: **StreamWave** (top-left)
    87	- Language selector: English dropdown

    21	
    22	# Web Design Expert
    23	
    24	Expert web designer and brand identity specialist creating distinctive, cohesive visual systems for web applications.
    25	
    26	## When to Use This Skill
    27	
    28	**Use for:**
    29	- Brand identity development (personality, visual language, guidelines)
    30	- Color palette creation and rationale
    31	- Layout composition and visual hierarchy
    32	- Component visual design (not just code)
    33	- Responsive design strategy
    34	- WCAG accessibility review for visual elements
    35	
    36	**Do NOT use for:**
    37	- Deep typography work → use **typography-expert**
    38	- Color theory mathematics → use **color-theory-palette-harmony-expert**
    39	- Design tokens and CSS architecture → use **design-system-creator**
    40	- Retro Windows 3.1 → use **windows-3-1-web-designer**
    41	- Native app design → use **native-app-designer**
    42	
    43	## Core Design Process
    44	
    45	### 1. Discovery (Critical First Step)
    46	
    47	```
    48	BUSINESS CONTEXT:
    49	- What is the primary goal?
    50	- Who is the target audience?
    51	- What action should users take?
    52	- Who are competitors?
    53	
    54	BRAND PERSONALITY:
    55	- If this brand were a person, how would they dress?
    56	- Pick 3 adjectives for user's feeling
    57	- What should brand NEVER be perceived as?
    58	```
    59	
    60	### 2. Visual Direction (Provide 2-3 Concepts)
    61	
    62	Each concept includes:
    63	- **Mood board** (3-5 references with rationale)
    64	- **Color palette** (primary, secondary, accent, neutrals) — **Always in OKLCH format**
    65	- **Typography direction** (families, hierarchy)
    66	- **Layout philosophy** (grid vs freeform, density)
    67	- **Signature elements** (unique visual features)
    68	
    69	## OKLCH: The Modern Color Standard
    70	
    71	**⚠️ All color palettes must use OKLCH, not hex or HSL.**
    72	
    73	OKLCH is the 2024+ standard for professional web design because:
    74	- **Perceptual uniformity**: Equal L values = equal perceived lightness
    75	- **Better accessibility**: More accurate contrast calculations than WCAG 2.x hex
    76	- **Predictable scaling**: Math works (L=50% + 20% = L=70% that looks right)
    77	
    78	```css
    79	/* OKLCH format: oklch(Lightness% Chroma Hue) */
    80	--brand-primary: oklch(55% 0.22 265);    /* Vibrant blue */
    81	--brand-accent: oklch(75% 0.18 45);      /* Warm orange */
    82	--text-primary: oklch(20% 0.02 265);     /* Near-black */
    83	--bg-surface: oklch(98% 0.01 265);       /* Near-white */
    84	```
    85	
    86	**Essential OKLCH Resources:**
    87	| Resource | Purpose |
    88	|----------|---------|
    89	| [oklch.com](https://oklch.com/) | Interactive OKLCH color picker |
    90	| [Evil Martians: Why Quit RGB/HSL](https://evilmartians.com/chronicles/oklch-in-css-why-quit-rgb-hsl) | The definitive article |
    91	| [Harmonizer](https://harmonizer.evilmartians.com/) | Generate harmonious OKLCH palettes |
    92	
    93	**When presenting color palettes:**
    94	```
    95	Primary: oklch(55% 0.22 265) — Vibrant blue, strong CTA presence
    96	Secondary: oklch(70% 0.08 265) — Muted blue, supporting elements
    97	Accent: oklch(75% 0.18 45) — Warm orange, attention-grabbing
    98	```
    99	
   100	Never present palettes as `#3b82f6` — always convert to OKLCH.
   101	
   102	### 3. Design Principles
   103	
   104	**Hierarchy**: Most important element immediately obvious? Eye flows naturally?
   105	
   106	**Consistency**: Same colors mean same things? Spacing follows scale?
   107	
   108	## Common Anti-Patterns
   109	
   110	### Design by Committee
   111	| What it looks like | Why it's wrong |
   112	|--------------------|----------------|
   113	| Multiple visual styles on same page | Destroys brand coherence |
   114	| **Instead**: Establish principles early, enforce consistency |
   115	
   116	### Decoration Over Function
   117	| What it looks like | Why it's wrong |
   118	|--------------------|----------------|
   119	| Fancy animations without purpose | Slows performance, distracts |
   120	| **Instead**: Every element must earn its place |
   121	
   122	### Ignoring the Fold
   123	| What it looks like | Why it's wrong |
   124	|--------------------|----------------|
   125	| Critical info below viewport | 80% attention is above fold |
   126	| **Instead**: Hero must have value prop + primary CTA |
   127	
   128	### Low Contrast Text
   129	| What it looks like | Why it's wrong |
   130	|--------------------|----------------|
   131	| Light gray on white (#999 on #fff) | Fails WCAG, excludes users |
   132	| **Instead**: Minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio |
   133	
   134	### Mobile as Afterthought
   135	| What it looks like | Why it's wrong |
   136	|--------------------|----------------|
   137	| Desktop-first that "shrinks" | 60%+ traffic is mobile |
   138	| **Instead**: Design mobile-first, enhance for desktop |
   139	
   140	## Design Trend Evolution
   141	
   142	| Era | Trend |
   143	|-----|-------|
   144	| 2019-2021 | Subtle shadows, layering, dark mode |
   145	| 2022-2023 | Oversized typography, variable fonts |
   146	| 2024+ | Bento grids, claymorphism, grain, AI personalization |
   147	
   148	**Watch For** (dated patterns LLMs may suggest):
   149	- Flat design without depth
   150	- Hero sliders (proven ineffective)
   151	- Carousel galleries (low engagement)
   152	- Desktop hamburger menus
   153	
   154	## Output Deliverables
   155	
   156	1. **Brand Identity Guide**: Colors, typography, voice, do's/don'ts
   157	2. **Design Specifications**: Spacing, radius, shadows, animation timing
   158	3. **Component Examples**: Buttons, forms, cards, navigation (all states)
   159	4. **Responsive Guidelines**: Breakpoints, layout changes, touch targets
   160	
   161	## MCP Tools
   162	
   163	| Tool | Purpose |
   164	|------|---------|
   165	| `21st_magic_component_inspiration` | Search UI patterns for inspiration |
   166	| `21st_magic_component_builder` | Generate React/Tailwind components |
   167	| `21st_magic_component_refiner` | Improve existing component UI |
   168	| `logo_search` | Get company logos in JSX/TSX/SVG |
   169	
   170	## Integration with Other Skills
   171	
   172	Paired skills are bundled at `paired-skills/` in this skill directory. Read the corresponding SKILL.md when you need deeper expertise:
   173	
   174	| Skill | Path | Use For |
   175	|-------|------|---------|
   176	| **typography-expert** | `typography-expert/SKILL.md` | Deep typography decisions, font pairing, OpenType features |
   177	| **color-theory-palette-harmony-expert** | `color-theory-palette-harmony-expert/SKILL.md` | Color science, palette harmony, perceptual color spaces |
   178	| **design-system-creator** | `design-system-creator/SKILL.md` | Design tokens, CSS architecture, component libraries |
   179	| **vibe-matcher** | `vibe-matcher/SKILL.md` | Translating emotional vibes to visual DNA |
   180	| **design-archivist** | `design-archivist/SKILL.md` | Building visual databases, competitive research |
   181	
   182	## Reference Files
   183	
   184	| File | Contents |
   185	|------|----------|
   186	| `references/layout-systems.md` | Grid systems, spacing scales, responsive breakpoints |
   187	| `references/color-accessibility.md` | Palettes, psychology, dark mode, WCAG compliance |
   188	| `references/tooling-integration.md` | 21st.dev, Figma MCP, component workflows |
   189	
   190	---
   191	
   192	*The best design is invisible until you notice its excellence.*

steps.message:
Both pages are complete, validated, and ready. Here's a summary of what was built:

## Output Files
- **`/app/output/index.html`** — Main landing page
- **`/app/output/login.html`** — Login page

---

## Design System (OKLCH)
- **Backgrounds**: `oklch(0% 0 0)` (pure black) → `oklch(15% 0.01 280)` (elevated void)
- **Accent**: `oklch(58% 0.24 25)` — the cinematic red CTA color
- **Typography**: Inter (Google Font), weights 400–900
- **Spacing**: 8px-base scale with CSS custom properties

---

## index.html Sections
| Section | Key Features |
|---|---|
| **Header** | Fixed, blur-on-scroll, logo, language dropdown, Sign In button → `login.html` |
| **Hero** | Full-bleed tilted poster mosaic background with dark gradient overlay, bold headline, email capture form |
| **Trending** | Horizontal scrollable carousel with large translucent rank numbers, arrow nav, touch-swipe support |
| **Features** | 4 gradient cards in responsive grid (1→2→4 columns), bottom-right icons |
| **FAQ** | Accordion with smooth expand/collapse, only one open at a time, ARIA attributes |
| **CTA** | Repeated email capture form for conversion |
| **Footer** | 4-column link grid, language selector, reCAPTCHA legal note |

---

## login.html Sections
| Section | Key Features |
|---|---|
| **Header** | Minimal — logo only, links back home |
| **Login Form** | Centered card with email/mobile + password fields, Continue button, validation |
| **Get Help** | Expandable toggle below form with help links |
| **Footer** | Condensed link grid + language selector |

---

## Interactions Implemented
- **FAQ accordion** — click toggles one item at a time
- **Trending carousel** — prev/next arrows + touch/mouse drag swipe
- **Email forms** — both hero and bottom CTA accept input and submit
- **Login form** — validates fields on submit
- **Get help toggle** — expands/collapses help options
- **Header scroll** — gains blur backdrop when scrolled
